properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev/test tooling dependency of the Solidity library; no production Solidity code consumes it. This is the dependency inventory the scan is meant to record.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum-native signature scheme the shipped ECDSA Solidity library verifies; the JS test harness needs the curve to construct test vectors. Quantum-unsafe under Shor; the Solidity-side verification (ecrecover precompile) is fixed by the EVM protocol — test-side implementation is changeable here, on-chain scheme is not.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Weak-KDF practice is inherent to the vendored crypto-browserify stack behind the hardhat/ethereumjs tooling, not to code written in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test helper generating ephemeral RSA-2048 keypairs (node:crypto) for ERC-7913 signature tests; the companion signing path uses crypto.privateEncrypt with a hard-coded SHA-256 DigestInfo prefix (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5). Shor-vulnerable signing primitive, test-only; migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA, not the ML-KEM-768 the object's canonical RSA-ENC tag suggests. Sole site (signers.js:113) confirmed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Provides the secp256k1 ECDSA implementation the JS tests use to validate the shipped contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol. Shor-vulnerable; changeable here by bumping the package, though secp256k1 itself is what Ethereum mandates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Release workflow's isPublishedOnNpm() fetches https://registry.npmjs.com/<pkg>/<version> with Node's global fetch on default TLS settings; engines allow ^22.12 (no PQ group by default at that version — X25519MLKEM768 only from Node 24.5+). Public metadata only, no credentials; harvest-now-decrypt-later impact minimal. Changeable by pinning the CI runtime to Node 24.5+ or configuring default groups. Sole site (state.js:110) confirmed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (SHA-3 family) is Ethereum's native hash: every test hashes userOps, merkle leaves, storage slots, CREATE2 initcode and block headers with it. The same primitive backs the shipped Solidity modules (MerkleProof/Hashes/MessageHashUtils/TrieProof), reported as separate findings. Quantum exposure is Grover-only (square-root preimage speedup), so this is inventory rather than urgent migration.
